name: Hemoglobe's tick pays its full bonus-healing coefficient and Spirit/Stamina terms (#1978)
contract: Hemoglobe 524907 reads its tick 524906 as ${($524907d*1000/$524907t1)*($524906m1+$524906ppl1+$bh*0.1125+$SPI*0.45+$STA*0.35)}. Spell.dbc gives 524906 SpellLevel 35, BaseLevel 35, MaxLevel 60, DmgClass 1 (not NONE) and EffectBonusMultiplier 0. Without a spell_bonus_data row, Unit::SpellHealingBonusDone finds coeff 0 and adds nothing for any amount of bonus healing, so the harness's fixed base stays 1000 regardless. With only the spell_bonus_data row (direct_bonus 0.1125) but no IgnoreSpellLevelPenalty, Unit::CalculateLevelPenalty returns (35+6)/80 = 0.5125 for a level-80 caster (SpellLevel 35 < MaxLevel 60), halving the term: int32(2000*0.1125*0.5125) = 115, reading 1115. ApplyAscensionBloodmageHemoglobeContract sets IgnoreSpellLevelPenalty for this exact record shape (id 524906, family 26, effect 0 SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL, SpellLevel/BaseLevel 35, MaxLevel 60), so factorMod becomes 1.0 and the reading becomes int32(2000*0.1125) = 225 added to 1000 = 1225 - the full tooltip coefficient. Separately, bloodmage_vitality_scaling::ModifySpellEffectBaseValue (AscensionBloodmageVitality.cpp) now adds SPI*0.45+STA*0.35 to 524906's own base value (a different code path, SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue, exercised by the harness's spell_effect_value metric, not by spell_healing_done); Measured against the Spirit and Stamina actually gained (the Human racial raises Spirit by 3%), that reading must rise by 0.45 per Spirit and 0.35 per Stamina.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: with no bonus healing the tick's bh term contributes nothing
DISCRIMINATING: 2000 bonus healing adds its full 0.1125 coefficient once the level penalty is ignored
SETUP: the aura raised Spirit enough to dominate int32 truncation
DISCRIMINATING: the base value rises by 0.45 of the Spirit gained
SETUP: the aura raised Stamina enough to dominate int32 truncation
DISCRIMINATING: the base value rises by 0.35 of the Stamina gained
